steps.assertion: Open a prepared platform billing session
steps.text: Open **Platform billing > Sessions** and choose a session in **Draft** whose payouts are entered and whose bank receipt was matched.
Choose **Check** to run the accounting preflight.

steps.assertion: Generate customer invoices and commission bills
steps.text: Choose **Generate documents**: the customer invoices and the commission bills are created in draft.

steps.assertion: Post the documents and compensate commission
steps.text: Choose **Post documents**. The documents are posted and the commission is compensated against the revenue, so only the net amount is expected from the bank.

steps.assertion: Reconcile the selected bank receipt through OCA
steps.text: Choose **Reconcile bank**. The receipt matched to the payout settles the net amount through the bank reconciliation.
The session is **Paid**: the invoice, the bill and the bank line agree.

steps.assertion: Open the generated native accounting documents
steps.text: Choose **Journal entries** to see what was posted.

steps.assertion: Native posted accounting documents remain available
steps.text: Every document is a native Odoo journal entry, open to the usual accounting views and reports.

steps.assertion: Miscellaneous entries clearly require no payment
steps.text: The compensation entries read **No Payment Required**: they move the commission, they do not expect money.

title: Generate, post and reconcile a platform billing session
